title: paeonia pinnata
intro: Paeonia pinnata, commonly known as the Chinese peony or white peony, is a species of flowering plant in the Paeoniaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of Paeonia pinnata include reducing fever, relieving pain, and calming the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glycosides, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
